lastFeature: 0.5.27 SHIPPED (live, updater verified). Checklists tab feature lane (built on the VM): (1) new Checklists tab with three sections — Checklist Comments (search every checklist-level comment), Species Comments (search observation notes across all species, each leading with a clickable species name), and All Checklists (every outing with date/location/protocol/effort/counts/at-a-glance + comment); (2) composable filters — one pill per category cycles any→has→doesn't-have for checklist comment, species comments, media, breeding codes, weather block, tide block, plus Complete/Incomplete, photo/audio/video, protocol, county, date range; (3) tab-wide toggle to hide pasted weather & tide blocks (also excluded from search). New files: Checklists.tsx (+test), CommentText.tsx (shared safe comment renderer now used by List Comparer too), lib/checklistsTab.ts (+test); Help TOC now lists Named Birds + Checklists; PRIVACY_POLICY.md completed the Cornell Lab provider disclosure (Macaulay media + eBird/BoW link icons).
